title: The Fed says it set reserve requirement ratios to zero percent effective 26 March 2020
summary: The Fed says it set reserve requirement ratios to zero percent effective 26 March 2020.
body: The Board's reserve-requirements page says it reduced reserve requirement ratios to zero percent effective 26 March 2020, and that this action eliminated reserve requirements for all depository institutions. The source says: "Reserve Requirements As announced on March 15, 2020, the Board reduced reserve requirement ratios to zero percent effective March 26, 2020." A required reserve ratio of zero is the rule the Board states. A textbook multiplier that needs a binding reserve ratio is describing a constraint this page says was eliminated. How much lending actually occurs is a further fact this sentence does not measure.
